entities.name: Requested MBS container
entities.description: This information element is included in a message when the UE requests to join one or more MBS sessions associated with the PDU session.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The UE requests to join MBS sessions by including the Requested MBS container IE in a message.

entities.name: MBS session
entities.description: One or more MBS sessions that are associated with the PDU session and which the UE requests to join.

entities.name: PDU session
entities.description: The PDU session with which the MBS sessions are associated.

relations.description: The UE triggers the inclusion of the Requested MBS container IE in a message to request joining MBS sessions.
The Requested MBS container IE is used to request joining one or more MBS sessions.
The MBS sessions are associated with the PDU session.
